🥃 Five countries. Five whiskeys. One unforgettable evening.
What a night at Sixth Sense as we took our guests on a whiskey journey around the world 🌎

🇯🇵 Japan • 🇮🇳 India • 🇦🇺 Australia • 🇺🇸 Kentucky • 🇮🇪 Ireland

From bold and smoky to smooth and complex, each pour brought its own character, story, and flavour to the table.

A celebration of great whiskey, good company, and unforgettable moments. 🥃✨

Thank you to everyone who joined us for the journey. Until the next pour…
